"""Owned native cold/replacement fill experiment; no source or native file operations."""
import ast
import cProfile
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from PySide6 import __version__ as pyside_version
from PySide6.QtCore import QItemSelectionModel, QPersistentModelIndex, Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from je_file_tree.core.node import Node
from je_file_tree.gui import grouped_list, i18n
from je_file_tree.gui.tree_model import NODE_ROLE

variant, groups, members = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])
fill = grouped_list.fill
if variant in ('baseline', 'defer'):
    path = Path('build/grouped-list-fill-baseline.py')
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    function = next(item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == 'fill')
    loop = function.body[-1]
    assert isinstance(loop, ast.For) and ast.unparse(loop.body[0]).startswith('view.expand(')
    if variant == 'defer':
        function.body.insert(-1, ast.parse('view.scheduleDelayedItemsLayout()').body[0])
    ast.fix_missing_locations(function)
    namespace = vars(grouped_list).copy()
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]), str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
    fill = namespace['fill']
elif variant != 'final':
    raise ValueError(variant)

app = QApplication([])
i18n.set_language('en')
root = Node('owned-grouped-fill-probe', True, children=[])
captured = [[Node(f'{group}-{row:07}', False, size=1536, parent=root)
             for row in range(members)] for group in range(groups)]
root.children.extend(node for nodes in captured for node in nodes)
source = tuple(root.children)
model = grouped_list.GroupedListModel()
view = grouped_list.build_view(model)
view.setAttribute(Qt.WA_DontShowOnScreen)
view.resize(1000, 600)
view.show()
for _ in range(3):
    app.processEvents()
notifications = []
view.expanded.connect(lambda index: notifications.append(index.row()))
records = []
profile = cProfile.Profile() if '--profile' in sys.argv else None
for phase in ['cold', 'replacement']:
    old = QPersistentModelIndex(model.index(members - 1, 0, model.index(groups - 1, 0)))
    if old.isValid():
        view.selectionModel().setCurrentIndex(old, QItemSelectionModel.ClearAndSelect | QItemSelectionModel.Rows)
    notifications.clear()
    if profile:
        profile.enable()
    started = time.perf_counter()
    fill(model, view, [(f'group {row}', nodes) for row, nodes in enumerate(captured)], 'auto',
         keepers=[nodes[0] for nodes in captured])
    handler = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
    passes = []
    for _ in range(3):
        app.processEvents()
        passes.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
    if profile:
        profile.disable()
    parent = model.index(groups - 1, 0)
    last = model.index(members - 1, 0, parent)
    verified = (tuple(root.children) == source and not old.isValid()
                and model.rowCount() == groups
                and all(model.rowCount(model.index(row, 0)) == members for row in range(groups))
                and all(view.isExpanded(model.index(row, 0)) for row in range(groups))
                and all(view.isFirstColumnSpanned(row, model.index(row, 0).parent()) for row in range(groups))
                and last.data(NODE_ROLE) is captured[-1][-1]
                and notifications == list(range(groups))
                and not view.selectionModel().selectedRows())
    assert verified
    view.scrollTo(last)
    app.processEvents()
    assert not view.visualRect(last).isEmpty() and view.visualRect(last).intersects(view.viewport().rect())
    records.append({'phase': phase, 'handler_ms': handler, 'event_passes_ms': passes,
                    'expanded_signals': len(notifications), 'verified': verified,
                    'viewport': view.viewport().geometry().getRect(), 'row_height': view.rowHeight(last),
                    'columns': [view.columnWidth(column) for column in range(4)]})
if profile:
    profile.dump_stats(f'build/grouped-fill-{variant}-{groups}-{members}.prof')
print(json.dumps({'variant': variant, 'qt_binding': pyside_version, 'platform': app.platformName(),
                  'groups': groups, 'members': groups * members, 'profiled': bool(profile), 'records': records}))
view.setModel(None)
view.close()

import sys

script = Path('build/measure_grouped_display.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
prefix = script.split('panel._rebuild()\n', 1)[0]
if '--many-photos' in sys.argv:

    prefix = prefix.replace('else (2, 600)', 'else (500, 2)')
    prefix = prefix.replace("Image.new('RGB', (8, 8), 'red')", "Image.new('RGB', (128, 128), 'red')")
imports, construction = prefix.split('app = QApplication([])', 1)
exec(compile(imports, 'build/measure_grouped_display.py', 'exec'))
from je_file_tree.gui import grouped_list

variant = 'baseline' if '--cold-baseline' in sys.argv else 'final'
if variant == 'baseline':
    tree = ast.parse(Path('build/grouped-list-fill-baseline.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    function = next(item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == 'fill')
    namespace = vars(grouped_list).copy()
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]), 'build/grouped-list-fill-baseline.py', 'exec'), namespace)
    grouped_list.fill = namespace['fill']
exec(compile('app = QApplication([])' + construction, 'build/measure_grouped_display.py', 'exec'))
case_kind = kind + ('-many' if '--many-photos' in sys.argv else '')
repeat = int(next((arg.split('=', 1)[1] for arg in sys.argv if arg.startswith('--repeat=')), '1'))
snapshot_suffix = '' if repeat == 1 else f'-repeat{repeat}'
panel.setAttribute(Qt.WA_DontShowOnScreen)
panel.resize(1000, 600)
panel.show()
for _ in range(3):
    app.processEvents()
records = []
for phase in ['cold', 'replacement']:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    panel._rebuild()
    if kind != 'cleanup':
        panel._update()
    handler = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
    passes = []
    for _ in range(3):
        app.processEvents()
        passes.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
    displayed = tuple(node for group in panel.model._groups for node in group.nodes)
    expected_members = len(source) if kind != 'photos' else 1000
    verified = (tuple(root.children) == source and len(displayed) == expected_members
                and all(panel.view.isExpanded(panel.model.index(row, 0)) for row in range(panel.model.rowCount()))
                and not getattr(panel, 'running', False))
    assert verified
    snapshot = f'build/grouped-fill-panel-{pyside6_version}-{case_kind}-{variant}-{phase}{snapshot_suffix}.png'
    assert panel.grab().save(snapshot)
    if '--many-photos' in sys.argv:
        parent = panel.model.index(panel.model.rowCount() - 1, 0)
        last = panel.model.index(panel.model.rowCount(parent) - 1, 0, parent)
        panel.view.scrollTo(last)
        app.processEvents()
        assert panel.view.visualRect(last).intersects(panel.view.viewport().rect())
    records.append({'phase': phase, 'handler_ms': handler, 'event_passes_ms': passes,
                    'members': len(displayed), 'groups': panel.model.rowCount(), 'verified': verified,
                    'columns': [panel.view.columnWidth(column) for column in range(4)],
                    'snapshot': snapshot})
print(json.dumps({'kind': case_kind, 'variant': variant, 'qt_binding': pyside6_version, 'repeat': repeat,
                  'platform': app.platformName(), 'records': records}))
panel.stop(wait=True)
panel.view.setModel(None)
panel.close()

"""Owned-child diagnostics preserve native outcomes and cannot extend/retry helper execution."""
import ctypes
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace
import pytest
from tools import observed_process as runner
from tools import windows_child_observer as native
from tools.windows_share_probe import _helper_record

@pytest.mark.parametrize('code', [0, 7])
def test_normal_and_failed_children_keep_exact_streams_and_status(code):
    command = [sys.executable, '-c', f"import sys;print('out');print('err',file=sys.stderr);sys.exit({code})"]
    result = runner.run_observed(command, timeout=10)
    assert result.returncode == code and result.stdout.strip() == b'out' and (result.stderr.strip() == b'err')
    assert result.process_observation == {'status': 'not-sampled'}

def test_checked_failure_preserves_observation_and_actual_exit(monkeypatch):
    observed = {'status': 'modeled-observation-failure'}
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, '_Observer', lambda _pid: SimpleNamespace(finish=lambda: observed))
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner.sys, 'platform', 'win32')
    command = [sys.executable, '-c', "import time,sys;time.sleep(.2);print('kept');sys.exit(7)"]
    with pytest.raises(subprocess.CalledProcessError) as caught:
        runner.run_observed(command, timeout=10, check=True, sample_after=0.02)
    assert caught.value.returncode == 7 and caught.value.stdout.strip() == b'kept'
    assert caught.value.process_observation is observed
    assert _helper_record(caught.value, time.monotonic())['process_observation'] is observed

def test_timeout_keeps_all_output_once_reaps_child_and_does_not_retry(monkeypatch):
    seen = []
    original = runner.subprocess.Popen

    def launch(*args, **kwargs):
        process = original(*args, **kwargs)
        seen.append(process)
        return process
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner.subprocess, 'Popen', launch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, '_Observer', lambda _pid: SimpleNamespace(finish=lambda: {'status': 'test'}))
    command = [sys.executable, '-c', "import time,sys;time.sleep(.7);print('once',flush=True);print('error',file=sys.stderr,flush=True);time.sleep(30)"]
    with pytest.raises(subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as caught:
        runner.run_observed(command, timeout=0.5, sample_after=0.1)
    assert caught.value.timeout == 0.5
    assert caught.value.stdout.strip() == b'once' and caught.value.stderr.strip() == b'error'
    assert len(seen) == 1 and seen[0].poll() is not None

def test_observation_error_does_not_replace_timeout(monkeypatch):

    class Broken:

        def finish(self):
            raise OSError('modeled read failure')
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, '_Observer', lambda _pid: Broken())
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner.sys, 'platform', 'win32')
    with pytest.raises(subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as caught:
        runner.run_observed([sys.executable, '-c', 'import time;time.sleep(30)'], timeout=0.3, sample_after=0.05)
    record = _helper_record(caught.value, time.monotonic())
    assert record['outcome'] == 'timeout' and record['process_observation']['status'] == 'observation-failed'

def test_second_wait_uses_remaining_deadline_and_preserves_first_partial_output(monkeypatch):
    waits, killed = ([], [])
    ticks = iter([0, 2, 3, 8])
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner.time, 'monotonic', lambda: next(ticks))
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner.sys, 'platform', 'win32')
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, '_Observer', lambda _pid: SimpleNamespace(finish=lambda: {'status': 'test'}))

    class Child:
        pid = 123
        returncode = None

        def __enter__(self):
            return self

        def __exit__(self, *_args):
            pass

        def communicate(self, timeout=None):
            waits.append(timeout)
            if timeout is not None:
                raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(['owned'], timeout, output=b'partial')
            return (b'partial-final', b'stderr-final')

        def poll(self):
            return None

        def kill(self):
            killed.append(True)
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner.subprocess, 'Popen', lambda *_args, **_kwargs: Child())
    with pytest.raises(subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as caught:
        runner.run_observed(['owned'], timeout=20)
    assert waits == [5, 17, None] and killed == [True]
    assert caught.value.stdout == b'partial-final' and caught.value.timeout == 20

@pytest.mark.skipif(sys.platform != 'win32', reason='native Windows owned-child wait-chain ABI')
def test_native_observer_reads_only_owned_live_child_and_balances_wait_session():
    assert ctypes.sizeof(native._WaitNode) == 280 and native._WaitNode.object.offset == 8
    script = Path(native.__file__).resolve()
    child_script = "\nimport ctypes as c, sys, threading\nfrom ctypes import wintypes as w\nk = c.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)\nk.CreateMutexW.argtypes = [c.c_void_p, w.BOOL, w.LPCWSTR]; k.CreateMutexW.restype = w.HANDLE\nk.WaitForSingleObject.argtypes = [w.HANDLE, w.DWORD]; k.WaitForSingleObject.restype = w.DWORD\nk.ReleaseMutex.argtypes = [w.HANDLE]; k.CloseHandle.argtypes = [w.HANDLE]\nmutex = k.CreateMutexW(None, True, None)\nif not mutex: raise c.WinError(c.get_last_error())\ndef wait():\n    if k.WaitForSingleObject(mutex, 10000) == 0: k.ReleaseMutex(mutex)\nworker = threading.Thread(target=wait)\nworker.start()\nprint('ready', flush=True)\nsys.stdin.readline()\nk.ReleaseMutex(mutex)\nworker.join()\nk.CloseHandle(mutex)\n"
    with subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', child_script], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE) as child:
        try:
            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script), '--pid', str(child.pid)], capture_output=True, timeout=10, check=True)
            records = [json.loads(line) for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]
            assert records[0]['event'] == 'identity' and records[0]['pid'] == child.pid
            assert records[0]['parent_pid'] == os.getpid() and records[0]['cpu']['exited_100ns'] == 0
            created = records[0]['cpu']['created_100ns']
            assert all((record['emitted_filetime_100ns'] >= created for record in records))
            assert records[1]['count'] > 0
            chains = [record for record in records if record['event'] == 'chain']
            assert chains or records[-1]['event'] == 'wait-session-error'
            for chain in chains:
                if chain.get('nodes'):
                    assert chain['nodes'][0]['pid'] == child.pid
                assert len(chain.get('nodes', [])) <= 16
                if 'query_before_filetime_100ns' in chain:
                    assert created <= chain['query_before_filetime_100ns'] <= chain['query_after_filetime_100ns']
                    assert chain['query_after_filetime_100ns'] <= chain['emitted_filetime_100ns']
        finally:
            stdout, _stderr = child.communicate(b'release\n', timeout=5)
        assert stdout.strip() == b'ready' and child.returncode == 0
